Title: **The 2026 YouTube Algorithm Explained (What Actually Changed)**

If you feel like the YouTube algorithm is killing your channel's growth, you might be making the wrong videos. In this video, we show you how to work with the algorithm so it actually helps you grow as a creator.

The algorithm isn't working against you; it's your matchmaker. Its only goal is to find the perfect viewer for your video. When your videos underperform, it's a sign that the algorithm doesn't know who to show your video to. This guide will teach you the 7 key strategies to fix that.

We'll cover everything from focusing on your "first audience" to finding outlier video ideas and leveraging search-based discovery to get more views.

In this YouTube algorithm tutorial, you will learn:

Tip \#1: Why the Algorithm is Your "Matchmaker" (Not Your Enemy)

Tip \#2: The Power of Your "First Audience"

Tip \#3: How to Find Outlier Video Ideas (Success Leaves Clues)

Tip \#4: Why You Should Build a "Viewer Journey" (Not Just Random Videos)

Tip \#5: Why Search-Based Discovery is Still Key (ASQ & RSP)

Tip \#6: Discoverability Has Never Been Easier for Small Channels

Tip \#7: The \#1 Secret to Algorithm Success: Riches are in the Niches

Our mission here at Think Media is to help purpose-driven entrepreneurs go full-time doing what they love and making an impact through the power of video.
